final:
isqrt(n: int) -> int =
  pre n >= 0
  post out >= 0
  post out * out <= n
  post (out + 1) * (out + 1) > n
  ex isqrt(0) == 0
  ex isqrt(1) == 1
  ex isqrt(15) == 3
  ex isqrt(16) == 4
  var lo = 0
  var hi = 3037000500
  while hi - lo > 1
    let mid = lo + (hi - lo) // 2
    if mid * mid <= n
      lo = mid
    else
      hi = mid
  lo

test_isqrt() =
  assert isqrt(0) == 0
  assert isqrt(1) == 1
  assert isqrt(15) == 3
  assert isqrt(16) == 4
  assert isqrt(17) == 4
